approval.approvedProductDecisions: Single passive ring, normalized 0–100, optional center, normal/warning/critical/muted states and no actions; finite clamping and NaN/±Infinity unavailable behavior; sm/md/lg diameters 40/56/80px with md (56px) default; numeric CSS-pixel ring diameter confirmed, e.g. size={64}; existing DS or Tailwind default tokens allowed for appearance.
approval.scope: Overall Draft, not exact-version or implementation approval. Naming/API, meter/accessibility semantics, non-normal stateText, refs/native restrictions, default unavailable wording, visual references, exact token/Material mappings and the mandatory stylesheet exception remain proposed.
approval.numericCustomization: Confirmed ability: size?: GaugeSize | number; numeric ring diameter is CSS pixels, e.g. 64. Finite-positive validation, invalid-size behavior and any min/max policy still need review; no arbitrary bounds or overall API approval. Measurement value remains normalized 0–100.
